TAX 28:28

The simple tax system for the 21st century.

Fair, social and innovative.

No more than 28 % on any income — and 28 % for corporations, platforms, heirs and large fortunes too. Plus a digital dividend of 515 € a month for every adult, from day one.

And the gains of progress pass us by. Four cracks in today's system:

Profit shifting after Tørsløv, Wier and Zucman; the ifo Institute, working from the country-by-country reports of large groups, arrives at much lower figures. German rules on earnings while on basic income support, as of 2026. Profit per employed person: own analysis of the OECD country-by-country reports, dataset DSD_CBCR@DF_CBCRI, 2023, sub-groups with positive profit.

Ten components, one principle

Every element is already proven somewhere in the world — from Estonia's digital administration and land tax to Alaska's dividend. 28:28 assembles them into a load-bearing system.

Component 01 · Income

Bracket tariff with a hard ceiling

0 %up to 12,348 €
9 %up to 25,000 €
19 %up to 40,000 €
24 %up to 55,000 €
27 %up to 70,000 €
28 %above — ceiling

The base is gross income — no deductions, no joint filing. Subsistence income stays tax-free; above it, work pays at every level.

Component 02 · Capital

Capital and labour treated alike

28 % on all returns

Realised gains count too. Reclassifying wages as capital income no longer pays.

Component 03 · Inheritance

Inherited income is income

28 % above 200,000 € per acquisition

One rate, no exemptions. Anyone inheriting a business or a home can defer the tax: initially at the state’s own refinancing rate, rising over ten years to the market lending rate. Nothing is written off – the outstanding balance stays as a charge on the asset and falls due on sale.

Component 04 · Wealth and land

Large fortunes and valuable land contribute

1 % above 2 m € · property tax on land only

Wealth up to 2 m € is left practically untouched. Property tax follows the value of the plot alone, not the house on it — as it already does in Baden-Württemberg since 2025 and in Estonia since 1993. Building or renovating no longer raises the bill; unused building land in a good location pays. The tax may not be passed on to tenants.

Component 05 · Corporations and platforms

Taxed where the customers are

28 % at the place of use

This applies expressly to digital platforms. Profits can be moved; a customer base cannot.

Component 06 · Consumption

VAT becomes a label

A+ · 5 %basics, repair
A · 11 %sustainable goods
B · 20 %standard goods
C · 25 %resource-intensive
D · 28 %climate-damaging luxury

As with the energy label, you see at a glance what a product costs — and why. The more sustainable, the cheaper. Effective rate on a standard basket around 21.5 %.

Component 07 · Climate

A carbon price returned to everyone

European price path · returned through the dividend

From 2028 the carbon price is set by European emissions trading, not by the German parliament. 28:28 therefore sets no national price but calls for a common path along the agreed climate targets – a task for the club. The proceeds come back through the dividend: those who consume little gain. Tax breaks for fossil use end.

Component 08 · Dividend

The digital dividend

For every adult; children receive half. The amount is tied to the official subsistence threshold and rises by formula, not by election promise. It is taxable: at the bottom almost all of it stays, at the top 28 % flows back.

Component 09 · Protection

Nobody on a low income falls behind

Legacy guarantee · 40 bn € for targeted help

Anyone on basic income support, minimum pension or student support today receives at least the previous level — the hardship fund pays the difference. It also covers housing costs, care, disability and exceptional circumstances.

Component 10 · Work

More net from gross — for everyone

Social contributions 42 → 28 → 18 % · no ceiling

Contributions fall to 28 % at once and to 18 % with the next dividend step. In exchange, high incomes pay on every euro — no exceptions applies in both directions.

No exemption, but a fair transition

Today’s relief for business assets works most strongly where the largest fortunes change hands. It is abolished outright. Anyone inheriting a business or a home therefore faces a tax on assets that are not cash.

A deferral takes its place. Interest runs at first at the rate at which the state refinances itself; over ten years it rises to the market lending rate. Only the interest is payable as it falls due. For anyone who cannot carry even that, it is added to the outstanding balance. That balance stays as a charge on the inherited asset and falls due when the asset is sold or passed on.

So nobody has to sell in order to pay the tax – and nobody is given anything. Nothing is written off, nothing can lapse. The deferral stays a deferral.

Two futures, one choice

Four indicators from 2010 to 2035: the path to today, and from 2028 two futures — business as usual, or with 28:28.

history to 2025 without 28:28 with 28:28 (cautious assumptions)

Paths from 2028 are model calculations, not forecasts. Debt: the ratio net of the fund reserve. Inequality: a model estimate; only an order of magnitude of 2 to 5 Gini points is defensible. The carbon path is carried over from the earlier version.

Can the budget carry it?

Yes — in all three calculations, without a single year of shortfall. A cushion builds up before the first payment; after that, up to 1 % of GDP a year remains for flexible investment, and a further 2 % stands ready as a crisis reserve.

Even in the recession test the dividend is not cut. Only the annual adjustment pauses; its value then falls temporarily by up to 9 %. The state's existing structural deficit of around 2.7 % of GDP is deliberately outside this calculation — it would have to be closed on top.

Why the budget cannot tip over

A design is only as good as its safeguards. Five rules decide — not election campaigns.

Revenue first.

Corporations, platforms, capital, inheritances, large fortunes and land are taxed under the new law several months before the first payment. The dividend starts on a cushion, never on credit.

Formula, not calendar.

The dividend is half the official subsistence threshold. It rises in steps to 60 % as soon as the crisis reserve is full and investment is secured.

Never cut — only pause.

If the reserve is drawn on, only the annual adjustment is suspended. It is made up solely out of surpluses.

Reserve and investment fund.

2 % of GDP stands ready as a crisis reserve; beyond that, up to 1 % of GDP flows every year into schools, networks and railways. The state stays able to act without new debt.

Fiscal council, open figures, a fixed corridor.

An independent council audits every assumption annually; the actual figures are public monthly. As a last safeguard, the uniform rate may glide only by rule, between 25 and 30 %.

One model for many countries

Germany is only the worked example in this design. The system is built so that the economy is exchangeable: the same rules everywhere, national values everywhere. The aim is to win several countries for a joint start by 2028.

2026 · Open review
The models are published. Experts, administrations and critics are invited to recalculate them and name the errors.
2027 · Country files
For each interested country the same calculation is filled with national data — verifiable with EUROMOD, the EU's open tax-benefit model.
2028 · Joint start
The earliest realistic year after legislation and administrative build-up. Latecomers follow the same rule set.
from 2029 · Enlargement
Every further country strengthens the effect, above all in taxing profits where the customers are.
The same in every country

The uniform rate

One rate for income, for profits and for the top consumption step. It may glide only by rule, between 25 and 30 % — the corridor within which each country finds its value.

Different by country

The level of the dividend

It is a fixed share of national median income: 21.4 %, derived from the 515 € in Germany. Children receive half. The rule is the same everywhere; the amount follows the country's income level.

Works only together

The place of taxation

Profits are taxed where the customers are. This is the one component that grows stronger with every new member: the larger the group, the fewer ways around it.

Example: ten country files

The same rule applied to ten economies: Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium, Austria, Denmark, Slovenia and Estonia. Together 257.2 million inhabitants — 56.9 % of the EU population — and about 70 % of its output. Enhanced cooperation under the EU treaties requires nine member states, so ten files leave one place to spare. Not all of them have to take part. Slovenia stands for the ordinary case, a mid-sized euro country with no special role; Ireland for the hardest one. Under the single dividend rule, these are the monthly amounts for adults:

Size sets the standard

57 % of the EU population and about 70 % of its output. A group this size sets rules instead of following them — including towards the large platforms. Nine countries would already be enough for that.

Three of the five EU tax havens would be inside

Tørsløv, Wier and Zucman count five tax havens inside the EU: Belgium, Ireland, Luxembourg, Malta and the Netherlands. In 2016 some 117 bn USD of shifted profits flowed to Ireland, 90 bn to the Netherlands and 15 bn to Belgium. Three of the five are on this list; Luxembourg and Malta are not. All three would lose revenue — that calls for transitional compensation out of the other seven countries' additional receipts.

Nine cut, one raises

In nine of the ten countries the top income tax rate falls, in Denmark by 32 points. Only Estonia would have to raise it, from 24 to 28 %. With corporate tax it is the other way round: it rises in nine countries — in Ireland by 15.5 points — and falls only in Germany.

Nine are enough, ten are calculated

Enhanced cooperation under the EU treaties requires at least nine member states. The club could therefore start inside EU law, without waiting for unanimity among all 27. Ten country files means one country can decline without blocking the route.

Movement inside the club

The dividend ranges from 306 € in Estonia to 651 € in Austria; in purchasing power the gap is smaller. Workers enjoy full equal treatment. For arrivals without earnings a waiting period would have to be examined, of the kind Alaska applies to its dividend.

Pull from outside

Because top rates fall across the whole club, it becomes more attractive for high incomes and for new businesses — a counterweight to departures caused by the wealth and inheritance tax.

Why Estonia is in the club

With 1.4 million inhabitants Estonia is the smallest member — and today the closest to the construction principle of 28:28.

  • From January 2026 a single rate of 24 % applies to income, to distributed profits and to VAT. That is effectively a 24:24.
  • Property tax has been based on the value of the land alone since 1993; buildings are untaxed. That is component 04, in operation for over thirty years.
  • A tax return is filed digitally in minutes — the administrative precondition for component 01.
  • At 24.1 % Estonia has the lowest debt ratio in the EU: the pilot country with the most room and the least risk.

The hardest case: Ireland

Ireland is on this list because a design must not hide the winners of the present system. As an early joiner it is at the same time the least likely of the ten.

  • Corporate tax would have to rise from 12.5 to 28 % — the largest single step on the list. Irish corporation tax is also extremely concentrated: the Irish Fiscal Advisory Council reports that in 2024 three groups paid about 46 % of it, roughly 13 bn €.
  • Irish GDP is inflated by multinational accounting. Measured against modified gross national income, GNI*, which the Irish statistical office publishes for exactly this reason, the dividend costs 10.2 % — the same as in Germany, not the 5.6 % that GDP suggests.
  • Component 05 does not need Ireland. Tax falls where the sale happens, regardless of where the profit is booked. The component works unilaterally — that is its point. Ireland's accession buys something else: legal peace inside the EU instead of proceedings against a member state.
  • For the Irish population the arithmetic would be favourable: top rate from 48 to 28 %, a dividend of 626 € a month. What would be lost is a source of state revenue that depends on a few foreign groups — not the prosperity of the people.

What this calculation does not do: there is no multi-country model. Only the gross cost of the dividend at national income levels is calculated; tariff revenue, corporations, consumption, land, carbon and the contribution reform are not modelled per country. Existing benefits and contribution systems differ widely — Denmark and Estonia finance their welfare states largely out of taxes, so the lever of lowering contributions is largely absent there. Belgium, Ireland and the Netherlands would lose revenue from taxation at the place of the customer, which is not netted off here. Purchasing power differences are not calculated. This becomes defensible only with EUROMOD, which represents all tax and benefit systems on one basis.

Evidence status

What each figure rests on, position by position. Four levels: computed from an official source; own calculation with an approximation; computed from distributional assumptions; not computed. Today two rows are substantiated and two are open. Every new calculation moves a row.

PositionThe claimLevelBasis and next step
Component 01 · IncomeBracket tariff with a hard ceilingmodel estimateThe 2026 tariff and parameters are documented (§ 32a Income Tax Act). Revenue is estimated from the income distribution in three scenarios, not computed on primary data. The middle steps were raised from 16/21/26 to 19/24/27 % — not for reasons internal to the tariff but from the budget path: without that surcharge the stress scenario produces five years with a funding gap. The entry step and the top rate were left unchanged. That comes at a price: because the top rate is fixed at 28 %, raising middle steps hits the top only with a fixed amount — so the additional burden does not rise with income. Next step: official wage and income tax statistics by size class.
Component 02 · CapitalCapital and labour treated alikemodel estimateThe 2026 legal position is documented. The revenue effect rests on a realisation elasticity of 0.7 to 1.0 — an assumption taken from the literature. Next step: the capital income tax statistics.
Component 03 · InheritanceInherited income is incomesubstantiatedOwn analysis of the official German inheritance and gift tax statistics 2024 (245,540 acquisitions, 113.2 bn €). An inheritance of 150,000 € is taxed at an effective 13.5 %; one of 15 m € at 9.6 % — in that bracket 61.9 % of the acquisition is exempt. The business-asset relief covers 79.4 % of all business assets transferred and costs 3.9 to 5.1 bn € a year. Position 03 would raise 20.98 bn € instead of 13.28, that is +7.7 bn € — computed on an exact class boundary of the official statistics. The exemption is replaced by a deferral: the state loses nothing, the concession is limited to the bank margin of the early years and amounts to about 0.7 bn €.
Component 04 · Wealth and landLarge fortunes and valuable land contributeorder of magnitudeOwn calculation on the 2025 statistics of property tax values and on the value of land from the sectoral balance sheets: land value 3,529 bn €, of which 87 % sits on 17 % of the area. A rate of 0.22 to 0.44 % carries today’s 15.5 bn € of property tax. Position 04 is therefore a restructuring at constant revenue, not extra revenue — the 20 bn € booked in the model have been struck. A rate of 1 % would yield about 35 bn €, i.e. +20; that would be a different position and is not adopted. Next step: update the land value to 2026 from the new property tax values.
Component 05 · Corporations and platformsTaxed where the customers areorder of magnitudeOwn analysis of the OECD country-by-country reports, 2016 to 2023, 63 reporting jurisdictions. Tested with two apportionment keys and on a constant panel of continuously reporting states: for Germany +5 to +14 bn €, median +8. Apportioning by sales alone is a design choice — it makes the rule unilaterally enforceable but works less strongly against tax havens.
Component 06 · ConsumptionVAT becomes a labelmodel estimateThe five steps are set; their weights of 10/10/20/30/30 are an assumption. The middle steps B and C were raised from 17 and 22 to 20 and 25 %, which gives an effective rate of 21.5 % instead of 20.0 %. This is the regressive instrument in the model: because the consumption ratio falls with income, VAT hits lower incomes harder in proportion. That is why the base step of 5 % and step A of 11 % are left unchanged. Next step: map consumption expenditure by purpose onto the steps.
Component 07 · ClimateA carbon price returned to everyoneorder of magnitudeOwn calculation on the Third Act amending the German Fuel Emissions Trading Act. § 44(2) fixes the emission volumes to 2030: 301.0 → 180.6 m tonnes, −40 %. § 10(2) sentence 4 sets a price corridor of 55 to 65 € for 2026 and 2027. Revenue from national fuel emissions trading in 2026 is therefore 13.9 to 16.4 bn €. From 2028 the price is set by European emissions trading — a nationally set path is then no longer possible, hence the European wording. The removal of subsidies stays open: of the 65.4 bn € reported by the Federal Environment Agency (data year 2018) about 47 would raise revenue, 12.7 are electricity-price reliefs that never reach the budget — and several items have since lapsed.
Component 08 · DividendThe digital dividendsubstantiatedLevel and indexation are documented: 50 % of the official 2026 subsistence income, steps at 55 and 60 %. The twenty-year path has been computed with the corrected revenues: in all three scenarios no year has a funding gap, the cautious scenario reaches 99.5 % of the investment target of 1 % of GDP, and the 55 % step carries from 2032 there. The 60 % step is reached only in the optimistic scenario — it remains a goal, not a promise.
Component 09 · ProtectionNobody on a low income falls behindopenNot computed. The grandfathering guarantee and the hardship fund require a household microsimulation. That presupposes a data contract for SOEP or EU-SILC.
Component 10 · WorkMore net from gross — for everyonemodel estimateContribution rates and ceilings for 2026 are documented. That contributions can fall to 28 and later 18 % follows from the overall calculation and is only as sound as that calculation. Including civil servants and the self-employed is justified as equal treatment, not as financing: according to IW Köln, including civil servants costs the state 10 to 20 bn € a year, because it pays as the employer and still owes the existing pensions of more than 63 bn € (DIW). The contributions of the roughly 3.5 m self-employed not yet covered come to some 29 bn € — but as an introduction gain that entitlements follow. The budget reconciliation therefore does not count this amount.

■■■ computed from an official source and reproducible · ■■□ own calculation from an official source, with a design choice or approximation · ■□□ computed from distributional assumptions, no primary data · □□□ not computed.

This table is why the proposal can be checked: it also says where the figures are thin. The scripts are in the annex, the calculation steps in the logbook.

Every model is open

Nothing on this page has to be taken on trust. Every figure comes from the models below — complete, readable, recalculable.

Method

Revenue and budget are recalculated across the income distribution and tested in three ways — optimistic, cautious and with a recession. The uncomfortable figures are on the page too. Developed with the method of architectural design, in a working dialogue with an AI system.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
28:28 — GESAMTMODELL (Mikro, Makro, Haushaltspfad, Homepage-Daten)
Digitaldividende (DD) = 50 % des steuerlichen Existenzminimums (2026: 12.348 EUR/Jahr -> 515 EUR/Monat),
Kinder-DD = Haelfte (257,50 EUR). Aufstieg per Regel auf 55 % und 60 %.
Einheitssatz 28 % (ESt-Spitze, Kapital, Unternehmen/Plattformen, Erbschaft, MwSt-Topstufe).

Rechtsstand "heute": 2026 (§ 32a EStG 2026, SV-Rechengroessen 2026, Soli-Freigrenze 2026, Kindergeld 259 EUR).
Makro: Kalibrierung Projektmodell (Basis 880 / BIP 4.200 Modell-Mrd.). DD-Betraege werden in Euro 2026
gegen diese niedrigere Modellbasis gerechnet -> konservativ (Kostenanteil eher ueberzeichnet).
"""
import math, json, csv

# =====================================================================
# 0  PARAMETER
# =====================================================================
EXMIN_2026 = 12348                          # steuerliches Existenzminimum = Grundfreibetrag 2026
DD_EUR = {50: 515.0, 55: 566.0, 60: 617.0}  # EUR/Monat, gerundet (50/55/60 % von 12.348/12)
KIND_ANTEIL = 0.5
L = 28
TARIF_GRENZEN = [EXMIN_2026, 25000, 40000, 55000, 70000, float('inf')]
TARIF_SAETZE  = [0.00, 0.09, 0.16, 0.21, 0.26, 0.28]          # 0-9-16-21-26-28
MWST_STUFEN   = [5, 11, 17, 22, 28]                            # Label A+ ... D
MWST_GEWICHTE = [.10, .10, .20, .30, .30]                      # ANNAHME Konsumanteile
SV_AN = {50: 0.14, 55: 0.14, 60: 0.09}                         # AN-Anteil = Haelfte von 28 % bzw. 18 %
ERB_FREIBETRAG_KIND = 400000
KINDER_MIO, ERW_MIO = 14, 70

# ---- Recht 2026 (heute) ----
BBG_KV, BBG_RV = 69750, 101400
AN_KV_PV = 0.073 + 0.0145 + 0.018           # KV 7,3 + halber durchschn. Zusatzbeitrag 1,45 + PV 1,8
AN_KINDERLOS = 0.006
AN_RV_AV = 0.093 + 0.013
KINDERGELD = 259
WK_PAUSCH, SA_PAUSCH = 1230, 36
SOLI_FG = 20350

# =====================================================================
# 1  STEUER- UND ABGABENFUNKTIONEN
# =====================================================================
def est_2026(zve):
    zve = math.floor(max(0, zve))
    if zve <= 12348: return 0.0
    if zve <= 17799: y = (zve-12348)/1e4; return math.floor((914.51*y+1400)*y)
    if zve <= 69878: z = (zve-17799)/1e4; return math.floor((173.10*z+2397)*z+1034.87)
    if zve <= 277825: return math.floor(0.42*zve-11135.63)
    return math.floor(0.45*zve-19470.38)

def soli_2026(est, split=False):
    fg = SOLI_FG*(2 if split else 1)
    if est <= fg: return 0.0
    return min(0.055*est, 0.119*(est-fg))

def sv_heute(b, kinderlos=True):
    kvpv = (AN_KV_PV + (AN_KINDERLOS if kinderlos else 0))*min(b, BBG_KV)
    return kvpv + AN_RV_AV*min(b, BBG_RV)

def netto_heute(b, kinder=0, partner=False):
    sv = sv_heute(b, kinderlos=(kinder == 0))
    zve = max(0, b - sv - WK_PAUSCH*(b > 0) - SA_PAUSCH*(2 if partner else 1))
    est = 2*est_2026(zve/2) if partner else est_2026(zve)
    soli = soli_2026(est, partner)
    return dict(netto=b - sv - est - soli + kinder*KINDERGELD*12, est=est+soli, sv=sv)

def est_2828(x, saetze=TARIF_SAETZE, grenzen=TARIF_GRENZEN):
    s, prev = 0.0, 0.0
    for g, r in zip(grenzen, saetze):
        if x > prev: s += (min(x, g)-prev)*r
        prev = g
        if x <= g: break
    return s

def netto_2828(b, kinder=0, partner=False, anteil=50):
    dd = DD_EUR[anteil]*12
    sv = SV_AN[anteil]*b                          # keine Bemessungsgrenzen
    est = est_2828(b + dd)                        # DD steuerpflichtig, Individualbesteuerung
    kind = kinder*DD_EUR[anteil]*KIND_ANTEIL*12   # Kinder-DD steuerfrei (Annahme)
    p = 0.0
    if partner: p = dd - est_2828(dd)             # Partner: eigene DD, eigene Veranlagung
    return dict(netto=b - sv - est + dd + kind + p, est=est, sv=sv, dd=dd + kind + p)

def r_eff_mwst(stufen=MWST_STUFEN):
    return sum(w*s for w, s in zip(MWST_GEWICHTE, stufen))/100
R_EFF_HEUTE = 0.165                               # Projektannahme effektiver Satz heute

def konsumquote(n): return .95 if n < 25000 else .85 if n < 50000 else .75 if n < 80000 else .60
def mwst_mehrbelastung(netto):
    r = r_eff_mwst()
    return netto*konsumquote(netto)*(r/(1+r) - R_EFF_HEUTE/(1+R_EFF_HEUTE))

# =====================================================================
# 2  MAKRO: AUFKOMMEN UND AUSGABEN JE STUFE (Modell-Mrd.)
# =====================================================================
VERT = [(6,8000),(11,20000),(12,36000),(7,52000),(5,69000),(3,105000),(1,300000)]
S25, G25 = [0,.08,.14,.19,.23,.25], [12000,25000,40000,55000,70000,float('inf')]
def _grenz(b, r, g):
    for gg, x in zip(g, r):
        if b <= gg: return x
    return r[-1]
# Kalibrierung wie Projekt: 25er-Tarif + DD 6.000 = 284 Mrd.
K_EST = 284/sum(mio*est_2828(b+6000, S25, G25)/1000 for mio, b in VERT)

SZ = {
 'Optimistisch': dict(g_e=.030,g_a=.026,dd_idx=.02,verh=50,eti=.25,semi=.8,eps=.7,leak=.85,drag=.0003,schock={},schock_a={},hc=1.0),
 'Robust':       dict(g_e=.030,g_a=.030,dd_idx=.02,verh=20,eti=.35,semi=1.0,eps=.8,leak=.80,drag=.0004,schock={},schock_a={},hc=1.0),
 'Stress':       dict(g_e=.020,g_a=.020,dd_idx=.02,verh=0, eti=.50,semi=1.5,eps=1.0,leak=.70,drag=.0006,
                      schock={5:.94,6:.96,7:.98}, schock_a={5:20,6:20}, hc=0.7),
}

def est_aufkommen(anteil, eti):
    dd = DD_EUR[anteil]*12; tot = 0.0
    for mio, b in VERT:
        m0, m1 = _grenz(b+dd, S25, G25), _grenz(b+dd, TARIF_SAETZE, TARIF_GRENZEN)
        b1 = b*((1-m1)/(1-m0))**eti
        tot += mio*est_2828(b1+dd)/1000
    return K_EST*tot            # 25 Mio. Erwachsene ohne Markteinkommen: DD < Existenzminimum -> 0

def mwst_aufkommen(leak):
    r0 = 0.18; brutto = 350/(r0/(1+r0)); r1 = r_eff_mwst()
    return 350 + (brutto*r1/(1+r1) - 350)*leak

def einnahmen(anteil, sc, detail=False):
    t = L/100
    d = {
     'Einkommensteuer (inkl. steuerpfl. DD)': est_aufkommen(anteil, sc['eti']),
     'Kapitalerträge 28 %':                   45*(t/.25)*((1-t)/.75)**sc['eps'],
     'Mehrwertsteuer (Label 5–28 %)':         mwst_aufkommen(sc['leak']),
     'Unternehmen & Plattformen 28 %':        145*(t/.25)*math.exp(-sc['semi']*(L-25)/100),
     'Erbschaft 28 %':                        33*(t/.25)*math.exp(-(L-25)/100),
     'Vermögen-Mindeststeuer (anrechenbar)':  22*(1-0.02*(L-25)),
     'CO₂-Abgabe 100 €/t (netto)':            55,
     'Sonstige Steuern':                      165,
    }
    return (sum(d.values()), d) if detail else sum(d.values())

BAUSTEINE = {   # Zusatzeinnahmen (statisch, Modell-Mrd.), Annahmen gestuetzt auf DIW/UBA/Destatis
 'Vermögensteuer 1 % ab 2 Mio. (nicht anrechenbar)': 12,
 'Bodenwertabgabe statt Grundsteuer':               20,
 'Abbau klimaschädlicher Subventionen':             20,
 'CO₂-Pfad 100 → 150 €/t (voll ab Jahr 5)':          15,
}
def bausteine(t):
    return sum(BAUSTEINE.values()) - 15 + min(15, 3*(t+1))

AUSG = {  # Basisausgaben nach Transferersatz/RV/Verwaltung, SV-Zuschuss, Haertefall
 50: dict(basis=596, zusch=60, haerte=40),   # inkl. Bestandsgarantie (~5 Mrd.) fuer heutige Grundsicherungsbezieher
 55: dict(basis=596, zusch=60, haerte=40),
 60: dict(basis=576, zusch=90, haerte=42),
}
def dd_kosten(a): return (ERW_MIO*DD_EUR[a]*12 + KINDER_MIO*DD_EUR[a]*KIND_ANTEIL*12)/1000
def ausgaben(a): return sum(AUSG[a].values()) + dd_kosten(a)

# =====================================================================
# 3  HAUSHALTSPFAD 2028-2047 MIT REGELN
# =====================================================================
BIP0, START = 4200, 2028
INV, PUFFER, STARTPUFFER = 0.01, 0.02, 100.0
STUFEN = [50, 55, 60]

def simuliere(sc, mit_bausteinen=True, jahre=20):
    g_e = sc['g_e'] - sc['drag']*(L-25); g_a = sc['g_a'] - 0.5*sc['drag']*(L-25)
    E = {a: einnahmen(a, sc) for a in STUFEN}
    F, i, idx, idx_voll, letzter_schritt, rows = STARTPUFFER, 0, 1.0, 1.0, -99, []
    for t in range(jahre):
        bip = BIP0*(1+g_e)**t
        if t > 0: idx_voll *= 1+sc['dd_idx']
        def saldo(a, ix):
            e = (E[a] + (bausteine(t)*sc['hc'] if mit_bausteinen else 0))*(1+g_e)**t*sc['schock'].get(t,1.0) \
                + (sc['verh'] if t >= 2 else 0)
            x = AUSG[a]; aus = (x['basis']+x['zusch']+x['haerte'])*(1+g_a)**t + dd_kosten(a)*ix + sc['schock_a'].get(t,0)
            return e - aus
        # Regel 3: jaehrliche Anpassung an das Existenzminimum, solange der Puffer nicht angegriffen ist;
        #          ausgesetzte Anpassungen werden nur aus Ueberschuessen nachgeholt
        if t > 0 and F >= PUFFER*bip:
            idx *= 1+sc['dd_idx']
            if idx < idx_voll - 1e-9:
                kosten = dd_kosten(STUFEN[i])*(idx_voll-idx)
                if saldo(STUFEN[i], idx_voll) >= INV*bip and F - PUFFER*bip - INV*bip >= 2*kosten: idx = idx_voll
        # Regel 2: Aufstieg 50->55->60 %, fruehestens Jahr 3, Abstand >= 2 Jahre
        rest = max(F - PUFFER*bip, 0)
        if i < 2 and t >= 2 and t - letzter_schritt >= 2 and F >= PUFFER*bip \
           and saldo(STUFEN[i+1], idx) + rest/10 >= INV*bip:
            i += 1; letzter_schritt = t
        S = saldo(STUFEN[i], idx); F += S
        luecke = F < 0
        inv = min(max(F - PUFFER*bip, 0), INV*bip); F -= inv
        rows.append(dict(jahr=START+t, t=t+1, anteil=STUFEN[i], dd=DD_EUR[STUFEN[i]]*idx, dd_2026=DD_EUR[STUFEN[i]]*idx/idx_voll, dd_real=idx/idx_voll,
                         saldo=S, inv=inv, ziel=INV*bip, fonds=F, luecke=luecke, bip=bip))
    return rows

def kennzahlen(rows):
    return dict(saldo1=rows[0]['saldo'], min_saldo=min(r['saldo'] for r in rows),
                luecken=sum(r['luecke'] for r in rows), min_fonds=min(r['fonds'] for r in rows),
                j55=next((r['jahr'] for r in rows if r['anteil']>=55), None),
                j60=next((r['jahr'] for r in rows if r['anteil']>=60), None),
                invquote=sum(r['inv'] for r in rows)/sum(r['ziel'] for r in rows),
                inv_kum=sum(r['inv'] for r in rows), fonds_ende=rows[-1]['fonds'],
                dd_real_min=min(r['dd_real'] for r in rows)*1.0)

    P("\n"+"="*100); P("D | MIKROEBENE (EUR/Jahr, Recht 2026 vs. 28:28)"); P("="*100)
    profile = [

    def gini(pairs):

        for w, y in pairs:

        return 1 - 2*area/(N*Y)

        else:
            r = rob[j]
            mit['schulden'].append(round(OHNE['schulden'][k] - r['fonds']/r['bip']*100, 1))
            mit['gini'].append(round(OHNE['gini'][k]*gfak[r['anteil']], 3))
            mit['last'].append(round(OHNE['last'][k]*lfak[r['anteil']], 1))
    for key in mit: P(f"  {key:<9} ohne {OHNE[key]}\n  {'':<9} mit  {mit[key]}")
    out['zeitreihen'] = dict(jahre=J, ohne=OHNE, mit=mit)
    with open('modell-2828-daten.json','w') as f:
        json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=float)

/* 28:28 – Rechnerlogik (Recht 2026 vs. 28:28). Alle Beträge EUR/Jahr, Preise 2026.
   Quelle heute: § 32a EStG 2026, SV-Rechengrößen 2026, Soli-Freigrenze 2026, Kindergeld 259 €. */
const P = {
  exmin: 12348, dd: {50: 515, 55: 566, 60: 617}, kindAnteil: 0.5,
  tarifGrenzen: [12348, 25000, 40000, 55000, 70000, Infinity],
  tarifSaetze:  [0, .09, .16, .21, .26, .28],
  svAN: {50: .14, 55: .14, 60: .09},
  bbgKV: 69750, bbgRV: 101400, anKVPV: .1055, anKinderlos: .006, anRVAV: .106,
  kindergeld: 259, wk: 1230, sa: 36, soliFG: 20350
};
function est2026(zve){ zve=Math.floor(Math.max(0,zve));
  if(zve<=12348) return 0;
  if(zve<=17799){const y=(zve-12348)/1e4; return Math.floor((914.51*y+1400)*y);}
  if(zve<=69878){const z=(zve-17799)/1e4; return Math.floor((173.10*z+2397)*z+1034.87);}
  if(zve<=277825) return Math.floor(.42*zve-11135.63);
  return Math.floor(.45*zve-19470.38); }
function soli2026(e,split){const fg=P.soliFG*(split?2:1); return e<=fg?0:Math.min(.055*e,.119*(e-fg));}
function heute(b,kinder,partner){
  const sv=(P.anKVPV+(kinder===0?P.anKinderlos:0))*Math.min(b,P.bbgKV)+P.anRVAV*Math.min(b,P.bbgRV);
  const zve=Math.max(0,b-sv-(b>0?P.wk:0)-P.sa*(partner?2:1));
  const e=partner?2*est2026(zve/2):est2026(zve); const s=soli2026(e,partner);
  return {netto:b-sv-e-s+kinder*P.kindergeld*12, steuer:e+s, sv:sv};
}
function est2828(x){let s=0,prev=0;
  for(let i=0;i<P.tarifSaetze.length;i++){const g=P.tarifGrenzen[i];
    if(x>prev) s+=(Math.min(x,g)-prev)*P.tarifSaetze[i]; prev=g; if(x<=g) break;}
  return s;}
function neu(b,kinder,partner,anteil=50){
  const dd=P.dd[anteil]*12, sv=P.svAN[anteil]*b, e=est2828(b+dd);
  const kind=kinder*P.dd[anteil]*P.kindAnteil*12;
  const p=partner?dd-est2828(dd):0;
  return {netto:b-sv-e+dd+kind+p, steuer:e, sv:sv, dividende:dd+kind+p};
}
/* Effektive Abgabenlast (Anzeige "heute → neu"): (Steuer + SV) / Brutto; neu inkl. Steuer auf die Dividende */
function abgabenlast(r,b){return b>0?(r.steuer+r.sv)/b*100:0;}

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
ZEHN LÄNDERDATEIEN  —  Überschlagsrechnung zur Übertragbarkeit von TAX 28:28
Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, Niederlande, Irland, Belgien, Österreich,
Dänemark, Slowenien, Estland

Die verstärkte Zusammenarbeit nach dem EU-Vertrag verlangt mindestens neun
Mitgliedstaaten. Zehn Dateien lassen also Spielraum: Es müssen nicht alle
mitmachen, damit der Verbund zustande kommt.

METHODE UND GRENZEN (bitte mitlesen)
  Dies ist KEIN Mehrländermodell. Gerechnet wird ausschliesslich die Bruttokostenseite
  der Digitaldividende bei landesspezifischen Einkommensniveaus. Alle übrigen Bausteine
  (Tarifaufkommen, Unternehmen, Konsum, Boden, CO2, Abgabenumbau) sind NICHT je Land
  modelliert; der "rechnerische Satz" ist eine lineare Skalierung des deutschen Modells
  und ersetzt keine nationale Rechnung.

  IRLAND: Das irische BIP ist durch die Bilanzierung multinationaler Konzerne stark
  überhöht. Das irische Statistikamt weist deshalb das modifizierte Bruttonationaleinkommen
  GNI* aus: 334,0 Mrd. EUR gegenüber 602,4 Mrd. EUR BIP im Jahr 2025, also 55,5 %.
  Für Irland werden beide Bezugsgrössen gerechnet. Massgeblich ist GNI*.

QUELLEN (alle Abrufe September 2026)
  BIP nominal und BIP/Kopf 2026 (Projektion)   IWF, World Economic Outlook April 2026,
                                               abgerufen über Worldometer
  Umrechnung USD/EUR                           EZB-Durchschnittskurs 2026: 0,8611 EUR je USD
  Median-Äquivalenzeinkommen, Stand 2025       WKO, "Einkommen & Armutsgefährdung",
                                               Zusammenstellung aus EU-SILC
                                               -> KEINE Primärquelle, Werte vorläufig
  Spitzensatz Einkommensteuer 2026             Tax Foundation; Estland: estnische
                                               Handelskammer (24 % ab 01.01.2026)
  Unternehmensteuer 2026                       Tax Foundation; Estland auf ausgeschüttete
                                               Gewinne; Irland 12,5 %, für grosse Konzerne
                                               faktisch 15 % (globale Mindeststeuer)
  Mehrwertsteuer-Normalsatz                    allgemein bekannt; Estland 24 % ab 07/2025
  Defizit 2025, Schulden Ende 2025             Eurostat, Euroindikatoren 22.04.2026
  Irland GNI* und BIP 2025                     Central Statistics Office Ireland
  Verlagerte Gewinne, Einstufung als Oase       Tørsløv, Wier und Zucman,
                                               aktualisierte Zahlen 2019 (Daten 2016)
  Anteil 0-14 Jahre                            Weltbank; Estland, Irland und Slowenien
                                               geschätzt
  EU-Bevölkerung 2025                          Eurostat
  EU-BIP je Einwohner 2025 (41.570 EUR)        Eurostat
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Rahmengrössen
EUR_JE_USD = 0.8611          # EZB-Durchschnitt 2026
EU_BEV     = 452.0           # Mio., 2025
EU_BIP_PK  = 41570.0         # EUR je Einwohner, 2025
EU_BIP     = EU_BEV * EU_BIP_PK / 1000   # Mrd. EUR, 2025
L_DE       = 28              # Einheitssatz des deutschen Referenzmodells
PP_ERTRAG  = 0.55            # % BIP je Prozentpunkt Einheitssatz (deutsches Modell)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ Länderdaten
#  bip_usd  BIP nominal 2026, Mrd. USD        pk_usd  BIP/Kopf 2026, USD
#  median   Median-Äquivalenzeinkommen, EUR/Jahr, Stand 2025
#  k014     Anteil 0-14 Jahre, %              est     Spitzensatz Einkommensteuer, %
#  kst      Unternehmensteuer, %              mwst    Mehrwertsteuer-Normalsatz, %
#  defizit  Finanzierungssaldo 2025, % BIP    schuld  Schuldenstand Ende 2025, % BIP
#  bezug    Korrekturfaktor der Bezugsgrösse (nur Irland: GNI* statt BIP)
LAND = {
 'Deutschland': dict(bip_usd=5450.00, pk_usd=65303,  median=28891, k014=14,
                     est=47.5, kst=30.1, mwst=19, defizit=-2.7, schuld=63.5,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
 'Frankreich':  dict(bip_usd=3600.00, pk_usd=52083,  median=26459, k014=17,
                     est=55.4, kst=25.8, mwst=20, defizit=-5.1, schuld=115.6,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
 'Spanien':     dict(bip_usd=2090.00, pk_usd=41563,  median=20367, k014=14,
                     est=54.0, kst=25.0, mwst=21, defizit=-2.4, schuld=100.7,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
 'Niederlande': dict(bip_usd=1450.00, pk_usd=79918,  median=34466, k014=15,
                     est=49.5, kst=25.8, mwst=21, defizit=-1.6, schuld=44.4,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='OASE, 90 Mrd. USD zugeflossen (2016)'),
 'Irland':      dict(bip_usd=779.38,  pk_usd=140186, median=35138, k014=19,
                     est=48.0, kst=12.5, mwst=23, defizit=+1.8, schuld=32.9,
                     bezug=334.0/602.4, verlag='OASE, 117 Mrd. USD zugeflossen (2016)'),
 'Belgien':     dict(bip_usd=776.73,  pk_usd=65112,  median=31299, k014=17,
                     est=53.5, kst=25.0, mwst=21, defizit=-5.2, schuld=107.9,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='OASE, 15 Mrd. USD zugeflossen (2016)'),
 'Österreich':  dict(bip_usd=623.72,  pk_usd=67761,  median=36546, k014=14,
                     est=55.0, kst=23.0, mwst=20, defizit=-4.2, schuld=81.5,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
 'Dänemark':    dict(bip_usd=503.77,  pk_usd=83445,  median=36192, k014=16,
                     est=60.5, kst=22.0, mwst=25, defizit=+2.9, schuld=27.9,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
 'Slowenien':   dict(bip_usd=86.73,   pk_usd=40630,  median=20416, k014=15,
                     est=50.0, kst=22.0, mwst=22, defizit=-2.5, schuld=65.7,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
 'Estland':     dict(bip_usd=51.63,   pk_usd=37718,  median=17146, k014=15,
                     est=24.0, kst=22.0, mwst=24, defizit=-2.0, schuld=24.1,
                     bezug=1.0, verlag='verliert'),
}
REIHE = ['Deutschland', 'Frankreich', 'Spanien', 'Niederlande', 'Irland',
         'Belgien', 'Österreich', 'Dänemark', 'Slowenien', 'Estland']

# ------------------------------------------------- Die eine Regel: der Dividendenanker
# Deutschland: 515 EUR/Monat = 50 % des amtlichen Existenzminimums 2026 (12.348 EUR/Jahr).
# Als übertragbare Regel: ein fester Anteil des nationalen Median-Äquivalenzeinkommens.
DD_DE_MONAT = 515.0
ANKER = DD_DE_MONAT * 12 / LAND['Deutschland']['median']
KIND_ANTEIL = 0.5


def rechne(d):
    bip_eur = d['bip_usd'] * EUR_JE_USD                      # Mrd. EUR
    bev     = d['bip_usd'] * 1000 / d['pk_usd']              # Mio. Einwohner
    kinder  = bev * d['k014'] / 100
    erw     = bev - kinder
    dd_m    = d['median'] * ANKER / 12                       # EUR/Monat, Erwachsene
    kosten  = (erw * dd_m + kinder * dd_m * KIND_ANTEIL) * 12 / 1000   # Mrd. EUR/Jahr
    return dict(bip_eur=bip_eur, bezug_eur=bip_eur * d['bezug'], bev=bev,
                kinder=kinder, erw=erw, dd_m=dd_m, dd_k=dd_m * KIND_ANTEIL,
                kosten=kosten,
                quote=kosten / bip_eur * 100,
                quote_bezug=kosten / (bip_eur * d['bezug']) * 100)


R = {k: rechne(v) for k, v in LAND.items()}
Q_DE = R['Deutschland']['quote']
for k in REIHE:
    # Einordnung: das deutsche Modell um die Mehr- oder Minderkosten verschoben
    R[k]['l_impl'] = L_DE + (R[k]['quote_bezug'] - Q_DE) / PP_ERTRAG

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- Ausgabe
def de(x, n=0):
    return f'{x:,.{n}f}'.replace(',', '§').replace('.', ',').replace('§', '.')

print('=' * 104)
print('ZEHN LÄNDERDATEIEN  —  TAX 28:28, Übertragbarkeit (Überschlag, kein Mehrländermodell)')
print('=' * 104)
print(f'Anker der Dividendenregel: {ANKER*100:.2f} % des nationalen Median-Äquivalenzeinkommens')
print(f'  abgeleitet aus Deutschland: {DD_DE_MONAT:.0f} EUR/Monat bei Median {de(LAND["Deutschland"]["median"])} EUR')
print(f'  Kinder: {KIND_ANTEIL*100:.0f} % des Erwachsenenbetrags')
print(f'  Umrechnung: {EUR_JE_USD} EUR je USD (EZB-Durchschnitt 2026)')
print()

print('[1] GRÖSSE DES KLUBS')
b_sum = sum(R[k]['bev'] for k in REIHE)
g_sum = sum(R[k]['bip_eur'] for k in REIHE)
z_sum = sum(R[k]['bezug_eur'] for k in REIHE)
k_sum = sum(R[k]['kosten'] for k in REIHE)
print(f'{"Land":<14}{"Einw. Mio":>11}{"BIP Mrd EUR":>13}{"Bezug Mrd":>12}{"BIP/Kopf EUR":>14}')
for k in REIHE:
    r = R[k]
    print(f'{k:<14}{r["bev"]:>11.2f}{de(r["bip_eur"]):>13}{de(r["bezug_eur"]):>12}'
          f'{de(LAND[k]["pk_usd"]*EUR_JE_USD):>14}')
print(f'{"KLUB":<14}{b_sum:>11.2f}{de(g_sum):>13}{de(z_sum):>12}')
print(f'  Anteil an der EU: Bevölkerung {b_sum/EU_BEV*100:.1f} %, '
      f'Wirtschaftsleistung rund {g_sum/EU_BIP*100:.0f} %')
print(f'  (EU-Summe {de(EU_BIP)} Mrd. EUR, Stand 2025; Länderwerte sind Projektionen für 2026,')
print(f'   die Wirtschaftsquote ist daher eher die Obergrenze)')
print()

print('[2] DIVIDENDE NACH DER EINEN REGEL UND IHRE BRUTTOKOSTEN')
print(f'{"Land":<14}{"Median EUR":>11}{"DD EUR/M":>10}{"Kind EUR/M":>12}'
      f'{"Kosten Mrd":>12}{"% BIP":>8}{"% Bezug":>9}{"rechn. Satz":>13}')
for k in REIHE:
    r = R[k]
    print(f'{k:<14}{de(LAND[k]["median"]):>11}{r["dd_m"]:>10.0f}{r["dd_k"]:>12.0f}'
          f'{de(r["kosten"]):>12}{r["quote"]:>8.1f}{r["quote_bezug"]:>9.1f}{r["l_impl"]:>13.1f}')
print(f'{"KLUB":<14}{"":>11}{"":>10}{"":>12}{de(k_sum):>12}'
      f'{k_sum/g_sum*100:>8.1f}{k_sum/z_sum*100:>9.1f}')
print('  Bei Irland weicht "% Bezug" vom BIP ab: Bezugsgrösse ist GNI* (55,5 % des BIP).')
print()

print('[3] WEG ZUM EINHEITSSATZ 28 (Prozentpunkte, + = Erhöhung, - = Senkung)')
print(f'{"Land":<14}{"ESt heute":>10}{"-> 28":>8}{"KSt heute":>11}{"-> 28":>8}'
      f'{"MwSt":>7}{"Defizit":>9}{"Schulden":>10}')
for k in REIHE:
    d = LAND[k]
    print(f'{k:<14}{d["est"]:>10.1f}{28-d["est"]:>+8.1f}{d["kst"]:>11.1f}{28-d["kst"]:>+8.1f}'
          f'{d["mwst"]:>7.0f}{d["defizit"]:>+9.1f}{d["schuld"]:>10.1f}')
print()

print('[4] GEWINNVERLAGERUNG')
for k in REIHE:
    print(f'  {k:<14}{LAND[k]["verlag"]}')
print()

print('[5] PRÜFGRÖSSEN')
n_ab = sum(1 for k in REIHE if LAND[k]['est'] > 28)
n_auf = sum(1 for k in REIHE if LAND[k]['est'] < 28)
print(f'  Spitzensatz sinkt in {n_ab} von 10 Ländern, steigt in {n_auf}.')
print(f'  Unternehmensteuer sinkt in {sum(1 for k in REIHE if LAND[k]["kst"] > 28)} von 10, '
      f'steigt in {sum(1 for k in REIHE if LAND[k]["kst"] < 28)}.')
print(f'  Rechnerischer Satz im Korridor 25-30: '
      f'{sum(1 for k in REIHE if 25 <= R[k]["l_impl"] <= 30)} von 10.')
print(f'  Spanne der Dividende: {min(R[k]["dd_m"] for k in REIHE):.0f} bis '
      f'{max(R[k]["dd_m"] for k in REIHE):.0f} EUR/Monat.')
print('  Verstärkte Zusammenarbeit nach EU-Vertrag verlangt mindestens 9 Mitgliedstaaten:')
print('  zehn Dateien lassen einen Platz Spielraum.')
print('  Von den fünf EU-Steueroasen bei Tørsløv, Wier und Zucman (Belgien, Irland,')
print('  Luxemburg, Malta, Niederlande) sind drei dabei; Luxemburg und Malta fehlen.')
print()

print('[6] WAS DIESE RECHNUNG NICHT ZEIGT')
for s in ['Bestehende Sozialleistungen, Beitragssysteme und Steuerbasen je Land.',
          'Kaufkraftunterschiede: 306 EUR in Estland sind mehr wert als 306 EUR in Irland.',
          'Dänemark und Estland finanzieren ihren Sozialstaat überwiegend aus Steuern;',
          '  der Hebel "Beiträge senken" fehlt dort weitgehend.',
          'Belgien, Irland und die Niederlande verlieren bei der Besteuerung am Kundenort',
          '  Aufkommen; das ist hier nicht gegengerechnet.',
          'Irlands Körperschaftsteuer trägt einen aussergewöhnlich hohen Anteil des',
          '  Staatshaushalts; der Übergang wäre dort der härteste des Klubs.',
          'Der Median-Wert stammt aus einer Zusammenstellung, nicht aus der Primärstatistik.']:
    print('  - ' + s)

# ------------------------------------------------------- Zahlen für die Webseite
import json
web = {k: dict(dd=round(R[k]['dd_m']), dd_kind=round(R[k]['dd_k']),
               kosten=round(R[k]['kosten']), quote=round(R[k]['quote'], 1),
               quote_bezug=round(R[k]['quote_bezug'], 1),
               l=round(R[k]['l_impl'], 1), bev=round(R[k]['bev'], 2),
               bip=round(R[k]['bip_eur']),
               **{x: LAND[k][x] for x in ('median', 'est', 'kst', 'mwst',
                                          'defizit', 'schuld')})
       for k in REIHE}
web['_klub'] = dict(bev=round(b_sum, 1), bip=round(g_sum), kosten=round(k_sum),
                    quote=round(k_sum / g_sum * 100, 1),
                    eu_bev=round(b_sum / EU_BEV * 100, 1),
                    eu_bip=round(g_sum / EU_BIP * 100),
                    anker=round(ANKER * 100, 1))
json.dump(web, open('/home/claude/site/klub10-daten.json', 'w'), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
print('\n-> /home/claude/site/klub10-daten.json')

ASSUMPTIONS AND SOURCES — TAX 28:28
As of September 2026. This list also names what is not evidenced.

1 | GERMAN LAW 2026 (basis of the calculator)
  Income tax schedule, § 32a EStG 2026, basic allowance 12,348 €
  Solidarity surcharge, exemption threshold 20,350 €
  Contribution rates and ceilings 2026: ceiling for health and
    long-term care insurance 69,750 €, for pension and
    unemployment insurance 101,400 €; employee share of health
    and care insurance 10.55 %, childless surcharge 0.6 %,
    pension and unemployment insurance 10.6 %
  Child benefit 259 € a month
  Average earnings 51,944 €
  Not included: comparison with the child tax allowance,
    church tax, work-related expenses above the standard amount

2 | PARAMETERS OF 28:28
  Bracket tariff 0 / 9 / 19 / 24 / 27 / 28 %
    thresholds 12,348 / 25,000 / 40,000 / 55,000 / 70,000 €
  VAT label 5 / 11 / 20 / 25 / 28 %, effective rate 21.5 %
    weights of the steps 10 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 30 % — ASSUMPTION
  Inheritance: allowance 200,000 € per acquisition, rate 28 %, no
    exemptions. Deferral for businesses and real property: rate in year t
    = refinancing rate + (t-1)/9 x margin, full market rate from year 10.
    No write-off; the balance is a charge on the asset, due on sale.
    Only the interest is payable as it falls due; the balance stays
    a charge on the asset. Present value to the state per 100 EUR:
    102 after five, 108 after ten, 121 after twenty years — no loss,
    and the longer the deferral, the more.
  Carbon: no nationally set price. Volumes under § 44(2) of the Fuel
    Emissions Trading Act (third amending act): 252.4 m t in 2026,
    180.6 m t in 2030. Price corridor under § 10(2) sentence 4: 55 to
    65 EUR for 2026 and 2027. From 2028 a market-based price following
    the EU ETS 1 average (§ 10(3) sentence 2 no. 4); transition into
    ETS 2, whose start Regulation (EU) 2026/667 postponed by a year.
    The price path is therefore a European demand, not a national one.
  Property tax: on land only, revenue-neutral. Land value
    3,529 bn EUR from the sectoral balance sheets; a rate of 0.22 to
    0.44 % carries today's 15.5 bn EUR. NOT additional revenue.
  Digital dividend 50 % of subsistence income = 515 € a month,
    steps 55 % = 566 € and 60 % = 617 €, children half
  Employee social contributions 14 %, 9 % from the 617 € step
  Crisis reserve 2 % of GDP, flexible investment up to 1 % a year

3 | BEHAVIOURAL RESPONSES (literature)
  Elasticity of taxable income 0.25 / 0.35 / 0.50 by scenario.
    Literature: Doerrenberg, Peichl and Siegloch 0.35 to 0.68;
    Werdt 0.36
  Semi-elasticity of reported profits 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.5;
    meta-analysis Heckemeyer and Overesch about 0.8
  Realisation elasticity for capital gains
    0.7 / 0.8 / 1.0 — ASSUMPTION

4 | EVIDENCE STATUS (in full in the "Evidence status" section)
  Substantiated from an official source:
    Position 03 Inheritance — Federal Statistical Office of Germany,
      inheritance and gift tax statistics 2024, statistical report
      73611, tables 73611-01, -04, -05, -06, -07. 245,540
      acquisitions, 113.2 bn EUR. Revenue at a 200,000 EUR
      allowance and 28 %: 20.98 bn EUR against 13.28 bn today.
    Position 08 Dividend — level and link to the subsistence minimum.
  Order of magnitude with a source:
    Position 05 Corporations — OECD, Corporate Tax Statistics,
      dataset DSD_CBCR@DF_CBCRI (1.1), 2016 to 2023, 63 reporting
      jurisdictions. Own apportionment under four keys, normalised
      on 26 continuously reporting states: +5 to +14 bn EUR,
      median +8. The single-factor key is a design choice.
  Not yet computed:
    Revenue from the land value charge
    Size of the climate-damaging subsidies to be removed. The Federal
      Environment Agency reports 65.4 bn EUR for 2018. Own allocation:
      about 47 bn of that would raise revenue, 12.7 bn are
      electricity-price reliefs with no budget effect, 4.8 bn are
      spending. Several items have since lapsed (EEG levy 2022,
      peak-load compensation 2023). A current edition is missing.
    Weights of the VAT steps
    Page count of tax law (the figure in the diagnosis)
    The share of winners is a model estimate, not a
      microsimulation. A check with GETTSIM or EUROMOD on SOEP
      or EU-SILC microdata is still outstanding.
  Open from the decisions on deferral:
    Transition gap of about 4.5 bn EUR a year over ten years
      (45 bn cumulative) — a pure shift in timing, but it belongs
      in the budget of the early years.
    Compatibility of the interest ladder with § 234 of the German
      Fiscal Code.
    Administrative effort at a 200,000 EUR allowance: the statistics
      do not say how many estates would newly have to be assessed;
      they only cover what reaches the tax office today.
    The assessed tax of 13.28 bn EUR is a gross figure; the
      remissions under the exemption needs test (§ 28a Inheritance
      Tax Act) are not included. The additional revenue is therefore
      understated rather than overstated.

5 | BUDGET RECONCILIATION
  Checks R1 to R6 corrected six items of the model, all downwards:
  inheritance 35.9 to 21.0 (allowance 200,000 instead of none); carbon
  70.0 to 33.0 (the statutory price corridor instead of 100 to 150 EUR);
  land levy 20.0 to 0.0 (revenue-neutral, see section 2); companies
  157.6 to 152.0; wealth 32.7 to 30.0. Together −80.2 bn EUR. The
  first-year balance therefore falls from +67.3 to −12.9 bn EUR.
  The path carries that nonetheless: the fund starts with 100 bn EUR,
  and investment comes out of the fund under rule 1, not out of the
  annual balance. What was tested is therefore not the annual balance
  but the twenty-year path. Without a counter-measure it has no gap
  year in the first two scenarios and five in the stress scenario.
  COUNTER-MEASURE: the middle steps of both taxes rise by 3 points —
  income tax 16/21/26 to 19/24/27 %, VAT 17/22 to 20/25 %. That yields
  38.9 bn EUR against a need of 36.1. After it no scenario has a gap
  year, and the cautious one reaches 99.5 % of the investment target.
  WHAT IT COSTS: because the top rate is fixed at 28 %, the increase
  hits the top only with a fixed amount. The additional burden runs
  from 0.86 % of income at the top to 2.45 % in the middle, so it does
  not rise with income. None of the 335 combinations tested avoids
  this — with a fixed top rate it is unavoidable. The net position
  including the dividend remains progressive.

  Reference point: this range measures the step of this change
  (VAT 20.0 to 21.5 %). Measured against CURRENT law (16.5 %) the net
  position including the dividend turns negative between 69,000 and
  105,000 EUR of market income.
  NOT COUNTED: including civil servants and the self-employed. It is
  justified as equal treatment, not as financing — see position 10 in
  the evidence table.

6 | NOT PART OF THIS CALCULATION
  The state's existing structural deficit of around 2.7 % of
  GDP. The reform balances in itself; it does not also repair
  the inherited position.

  Top income tax and corporate rates: Tax Foundation 2026;

  Shifted profits and classification as a tax haven:
